info.title: campus-core-api
info.description: Implemented HTTP surface: health only. School provisioning, academic setup/lifecycle, students/imports, guardian/staff relationships, attendance and lessons/homework are restricted operator CLI workflows. Homework submission evidence, versioned teacher reviews and absence catch-up packs are also operator commands; they add no HTTP endpoints. Identity integration (F02) remains deferred. HEAD mirrors GET. Optional private mTLS listener exposes one identity-authorized school-profile read. The public listener still serves health only; domain operator commands are not HTTP routes.

get.summary: Read the selected active school profile
get.description: Private TLS 1.3 listener only; caller certificate must contain exact URI SAN spiffe://campus/campus-api-gateway. Forward exactly one __Host-campus_session cookie. Online identity requires matching selected tenant and school.read; core then checks active/linked school and applies transaction-local tenant RLS. No names of individuals or learning content. Successful access audit commits before response. Every request is rechecked; no cached authorization or fallback. Already admitted work may finish after identity revocation. No teacher/guardian relationship access or mutation is granted. No HEAD alias. The common gateway routes this read.

get.summary: Read pending reviews for an assigned teacher
get.description: Private TLS 1.3 listener; trusted exact gateway URI SAN required. Runtime has only a narrow SECURITY DEFINER function with fixed search path and FORCE RLS; no direct domain-table read grants. GET only, no HEAD alias or request body. queue is required; limit defaults to 25 (maximum 100), with optional afterId. Reject duplicate/unknown/empty query fields, percent encodings, fragments and noncanonical UUIDs/numbers. Requires a fresh identity decision for core.teacher-review-queue.read.v1 / learning.review_queue_read and a current staff binding matching BOTH user and membership in the selected tenant. Core requires active linked school, staff, assignment and academic year. Guardian bindings and school.read alone grant no access. Cursor remains valid after processing its row, but must belong to the requested original section/year and queue. Return metadata only, never lesson/submission/feedback content. One REPEATABLE READ snapshot and atomic actor audit; access already admitted may finish after revocation. No authorization cache or retry.

get.summary: Read learning progress for a linked child
get.description: Private TLS 1.3 listener with exact gateway URI SAN. Runtime can execute only a bounded SECURITY DEFINER metadata projection, under forced tenant RLS; no direct domain table grants. Shared pure calculations keep operator and authenticated reports consistent. GET only; no HEAD alias or body. Both dates are required; reject unknown, duplicate, empty or percent-encoded query values. Requires fresh core.guardian-progress.read.v1 / learning.guardian_progress_read authorization, matching both identity user and membership to an active guardian binding and an active guardian/student relationship. Teacher bindings, school.read and teacher review permissions do not grant this access. School must be active and linked; guardian active; student registered. Enrolment may be active, withdrawn or completed, and the original year active or closed. Draft years, planned/cancelled enrolments and inactive students are denied. History preserves original enrolment/year and recorded sections. A 1–31-day report is bounded to 200 homework records, 31 catch-up packs and 20 lesson/20 homework references per pack; exceeding a cap returns 422, never silent truncation. Response contains metadata, explicit unmarked attendance and current completion/revision status; no names, evidence, guidance or feedback. One REPEATABLE READ snapshot and atomic verified-user access audit; decision expiry checked after DB acquisition. An admitted read may finish after a concurrent revocation. No authorization cache, retry or mutation.

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Real calendar date. Inclusive range is 1–31 days, within the enrolment academic year; year 0000 is rejected.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: Real calendar date. Inclusive range is 1–31 days, within the enrolment academic year; year 0000 is rejected.

200.description: No-store child-scoped progress metadata; access audit committed.

400.description: Invalid dates/window, unknown/duplicate query fields, body/encoding or ambiguous credentials. Dates outside the authorized enrolment year are invalid.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, revoked or stale session.

403.description: Selected school or dedicated guardian action denied; wrong service certificate on private core.

404.description: Unknown or inaccessible child/enrolment; no current guardian binding/relationship; disallowed lifecycle. Public core listener has no route.

503.description: Identity/TLS/database/contract/deadline failure or expired decision; fail closed.

422.description: Report exceeds its bounded record/reference counts; use a smaller date range. No partial report or access audit is committed.
